evals.prompt: Use the epic-orchestrate skill to describe how you would improve or resume an interrupted /epic-orchestrate run. Scenario: an implementation gate executor closed or updated issue AIT-123.2 before validation failed; a generated helper script later crashed on unsupported mapfile; validation found a missed parent-update path that can invalidate child records; an ait close command returned ok=false with close_incomplete_acceptance_criteria; no Pi executable or native subagent is available, but the current session can perform gates; and commands/tdd-task.md exists alongside an optional .pi/prompts/tdd-task.md. The run may need to resume. Do not execute commands. Return the controller rules and next safe steps, including gate execution fallback and template precedence.
